al-kindi.oneLineZh: 把希腊哲学翻译运动、第一哲学与伊斯兰一神论组织为阿拉伯哲学源头项目。
al-kindi.oneLineEn: Unites Greek translation, first philosophy, and Islamic monotheism as a founding Arabic philosophy project.

suhrawardi.oneLineZh: 以照明哲学改写伊本·西那、柏拉图主义光形而上学与临现知识路线。
suhrawardi.oneLineEn: Recasts Ibn Sina, Platonic light metaphysics, and knowledge by presence as Illuminationist philosophy.

vico.oneLineZh: 以 verum factum 与《新科学》开出历史、法、神话与语言的自造世界。
vico.oneLineEn: Opens history, law, myth, and language as human-made world via verum factum and the New Science.

schmitt.oneLineZh: 以主权决断、例外状态和敌友区分揭示现代政治危机，须置于纳粹牵连批判语境。
schmitt.oneLineEn: Exposes political crisis via sovereignty, exception, and friend-enemy; read critically amid Nazi complicity.

wasil-ibn-ata.oneLineZh: 早期穆尔太齐赖派奠基者，以理性神学、自由意志与中间地位开启 kalam 分歧。
wasil-ibn-ata.oneLineEn: Early Muʿtazilī founder opening kalām splits via rational theology, free will, and the intermediate position.

fakhr-al-din-al-razi.oneLineZh: 教义学与哲学神学家，在吸收并批判伊本·西那后重塑后期 kalam 问题格局。
fakhr-al-din-al-razi.oneLineEn: Theologian-philosopher who reshaped later kalām after absorbing and critiquing Ibn Sīnā.

ibn-tufayl.oneLineZh: 安达卢斯哲学家，以《哈义·本·叶格赞》写孤岛理性由自然升至宗教真理。
ibn-tufayl.oneLineEn: Andalusian author of Ḥayy ibn Yaqẓān, where island reason rises from nature to religious truth.

nasir-al-din-tusi.oneLineZh: 哲学家与天文学家，在后伊本·西那哲学、什叶神学与数学天文学间建立连接。
nasir-al-din-tusi.oneLineEn: Philosopher-astronomer linking post-Avicennan philosophy, Shīʿī theology, and mathematical astronomy.

rumi.oneLineZh: 波斯苏非诗人，以《玛斯纳维》将爱、合一与灵魂转化写成诗性哲学。
rumi.oneLineEn: Persian Sufi poet whose Mathnawī casts love, union, and soul transformation as poetic philosophy.

ibn-taymiyya.oneLineZh: 罕百里派法学家，以反哲学、反kalam、反苏非一元论与政治神学影响后世。
ibn-taymiyya.oneLineEn: Ḥanbalī jurist opposing philosophy, kalām, and Sufi monism; shaped later political theology.

mir-damad.oneLineZh: 伊斯法罕学派核心与萨德拉之师，以时间、永恒和创生问题组织萨法维哲学。
mir-damad.oneLineEn: Isfahan School core and teacher of Mullā Ṣadrā; frames Safavid philosophy via time, eternity, creation.

tabatabai.oneLineZh: 当代什叶哲学家与经注家，以萨德拉传统和《古兰经》诠释连接现代伊朗思想。
tabatabai.oneLineEn: Contemporary Shīʿī philosopher-exegete linking Ṣadrian tradition and Qurʾānic commentary to modern Iran.

al-afghani.oneLineZh: 泛伊斯兰活动家与现代主义先声，以反殖民、宗教改革与公共动员影响近现代伊斯兰思想。
al-afghani.oneLineEn: Pan-Islamic activist and early modernist shaping anti-colonial reform and Muslim public mobilization.

ibn-gabirol.oneLineZh: 以《生命之源》提出新柏拉图主义形而上学，拉丁经院称 Avicebron。
ibn-gabirol.oneLineEn: In Fons Vitae sets out Neoplatonic metaphysics; known in Latin scholasticism as Avicebron.

hostos.oneLineZh: 波多黎各教育家与伦理思想家，以社会伦理和安的列斯解放连接实证主义与反殖民。
hostos.oneLineEn: Puerto Rican educator-ethicist linking social ethics and Antillean liberation to positivism and anti-colonialism.

pseudo-dionysius.oneLineZh: 约500年托名传统，以否定神学、神圣名称和等级论影响东西方中世纪。
pseudo-dionysius.oneLineEn: Pseudepigraphic (~500) negative theology, Divine Names, and hierarchy shaping Eastern and Latin medieval thought.

michael-psellos.oneLineZh: 拜占庭博学者，以柏拉图主义复兴、宫廷观察与百科式学问连接古典与中世纪希腊。
michael-psellos.oneLineEn: Byzantine polymath joining classical and medieval Greek thought via Platonic revival and encyclopedism.

gregory-palamas.oneLineZh: 晚期拜占庭静修神学家，以本质/能质之分与《为静修者辩护》组织神秘经验论证。
gregory-palamas.oneLineEn: Late Byzantine hesychast framing mystical experience via essence/energies distinction and the Triads.

gemistos-plethon.oneLineZh: 晚期拜占庭柏拉图主义者，以《法律篇》和佛罗伦萨会议影响意大利古典哲学复兴。
gemistos-plethon.oneLineEn: Late Byzantine Platonist whose Book of Laws and Florence role shaped Italian Renaissance classical revival.

zoroaster.oneLineZh: 祆教先知，以善恶抉择、真理秩序与末世审判构成前伊斯兰波斯思想源头。
zoroaster.oneLineEn: Ancient Iranian prophet; good-evil choice, asha, and last judgment source pre-Islamic Persian thought.

aleksei-khomyakov.oneLineZh: 斯拉夫派核心理论家，以 sobornost 组织自由、共同体与东正教传统口径。
aleksei-khomyakov.oneLineEn: Core Slavophile theorist framing freedom, community, and Orthodox tradition through sobornost.

nikolai-chernyshevsky.oneLineZh: 俄国唯物主义者，以理性利己、现实美学与《怎么办？》影响十九世纪激进传统。
nikolai-chernyshevsky.oneLineEn: Russian materialist whose rational egoism, aesthetics of reality, and What Is to Be Done? shaped radicalism.

buddhadasa.oneLineZh: 泰国现代佛教思想家，以缘起重释、观呼吸与「法的社会主义」连接改革与政治伦理。
buddhadasa.oneLineEn: Modern Thai Buddhist linking reform and politics via dependent origination, ānāpānasati, and Dhammic socialism.
